themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints jumped to 11 THIS WEEK, a 126% spike above the 4.9 weekly average from the prior 8 weeks, signaling a potential sanitation crisis or environmental hazard emerging in South Beach/Dongan Hills.
evidence: 11 unsanitary condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.82)
Spike aligns with recurring CB budget requests for 'Other expense request for DSNY' (sanitation), suggesting systemic underfunding
No concurrent Reddit discussion or local news coverage yet—story is breaking at the district level
reporting_angles: What specific neighborhoods or blocks are generating unsanitary complaints? Are there common sources (restaurants, waste transfer points, illegal dumping)?
Interview DSNY about staffing, collection schedules, or service cuts in South Beach/Dongan Hills this past week

themes_detail.label: Lot Condition Complaints Skyrocket
themes_detail.summary: Lot condition complaints surged to 3 LAST WEEK versus a 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks—a staggering 2300% spike (z-score: 8.69)—indicating vacant properties, illegal dumping, or deferred maintenance emerging as urgent neighborhood issue.
evidence: 3 lot condition complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.69, severity: high)
5 active ULURP/rezoning applications in pipeline, including 336 Meredith Avenue Fleet Maintenance Facility (noticed stage)—suggests development pressure and potential vacant/remediation sites
552 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days, predominantly alterations (345), may indicate construction-adjacent lot degradation
reporting_angles: Which specific lots triggered the three complaints? Are they near active development sites or long-term vacant properties?
Interview DCP or CB about the five active rezonings—are they clearing blight or creating it?

themes_detail.label: Elevator Failures Surge Dramatically
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 4 LAST WEEK from a 0.4 weekly average—a 967% spike (z-score: 7.49)—suggesting potential safety hazards or code violations in multi-family buildings in this dense residential district.
evidence: 4 elevator complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.49, severity: high)
South Beach/Dongan Hills includes multi-story residential complexes where elevator failures directly impact elderly and disabled residents
No Reddit or local news coverage yet—breaking signal at 311 intake level
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings filed the four elevator complaints—are they clustered in one complex or spread across district?
Interview DOB about emergency elevator maintenance capacity; speak with building owners about deferred repairs or contractor shortages

themes_detail.label: Animals in Parks Spike
themes_detail.summary: Animal-in-park complaints spiked to 4 LAST WEEK from a 0.4 weekly baseline—a 967% increase (z-score: 7.49)—raising questions about wildlife management, park safety, or emerging pest/nuisance animal problems in South Beach/Dongan Hills parks.
evidence: 4 animal-in-park complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, severity: high)
CB has submitted recurring 'Other park maintenance and safety requests' and 'Reconstruct or upgrade a park or amenity' budget requests—suggests parks are under-resourced
Snow/ice complaints (3,607 total over 90 days) may have driven animals into parks seeking food after storm disruption
reporting_angles: Which parks are affected? Are complaints about coyotes, rats, aggressive dogs, or something else?
Interview DPR about wildlife management protocols and whether recent winter storms forced animals into urban parks

themes_detail.label: Street Signs Going Missing
themes_detail.summary: Missing street sign complaints jumped to 6 LAST WEEK from a 0.8 weekly average—a 700% spike (z-score: 5.42)—suggesting either vandalism, deterioration, or deferred DOT maintenance affecting neighborhood navigation and safety.
evidence: 6 missing street sign complaints last week vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.42, severity: high)
CB has submitted 'Other expense request for DOT' repeatedly in budget—indicates transportation infrastructure under-investment
Convergence with 309 traffic signal condition complaints over 90 days suggests broader street infrastructure degradation
reporting_angles: Is this vandalism or storm damage (snow/ice storms may have damaged signs)? DOT can provide repair timeline data
Interview residents about navigation problems; map which intersections are missing signs
